title: Ijwi ry'Ubuhendanyi
intro: Ubucuti bwageragejwe n’ishari ryinshi. Haciye hashirwaho umugambi w’ibanga, ushiraho uruhererekane rw’ibintu vyomara imyaka myinshi kandi bikajabuka ingendo ndende cane. Ivyo uwo mugwi wakoze vyatumye haba ugutandukana gukomeye n’umubabaro mwinshi, ariko iyo nkuru ntiyarangiriye ng’aho. Ni inkuru y'uguhenda, ukwicuza, n'uguseruka kw'iherezo kw'umugambi w'Imana. Woba ushobora gusobanura akaranga k’abo bantu amahitamwo yabo yasubirwamwo mu mayaruka yose?
clues: Twarariwe n’ishari kubera urukundo twagaragarije umwe mu bacu.
Mu ishari ryacu, twagiranye umugambi maze duterera umuvukanyi wacu mu mwiza w’iriba.
Kugira ngo twihishe ico gikorwa cacu, twarashikirije dawe impuzu, yari yandujwe n’amaraso y’ikinyoma.
Haciye imyaka, inzara ikaze yaraduteye kuja mu Misiri kurondera ivyo kurya.
Aho, twaje imbere y’umukuru w’igihugu akomeye, tutazi, akaba ari we muvukanyi nyene twari twagiriye nabi.
Ikigeragezo cacu ca nyuma cari ico kuzana umuvukanyi wacu mutoyi Binyamin, ivyo vyatumye kahise kacu kahishurwa kandi dawe wacu akaba Umuhanuzi Ya’qub.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَـٰطِـِٔينَ
verse: They said, "By Allāh, certainly has Allāh preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners." (12:91)
